summary: REQ-7 is largely implemented via a one-time claimAdmin() with an adminClaimed flag and admin guards on movie mutations/upload. REQ-8 is partially implemented (admin-only upload + frontend playback via videoBlob), but URL-based playback/backward compatibility appears broken due to removing videoUrl from the Movie type and migration dropping existing videoUrl data; also no explicit backend “retrieve bytes” API is shown beyond returning Movie with videoBlob.

missing_requirements.requirement: Existing URL-based video playback continues to work for movies that still use a video URL (backwards compatible).
missing_requirements.reason: The backend Movie type no longer contains videoUrl, the migration explicitly drops videoUrl (sets videoBlob = null), and the MovieDetailPage only attempts to play from videoBlob (no fallback to a URL field). This prevents existing URL-based videos from continuing to work after upgrade.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes admin-guarded methods to upload and retrieve a movie video file (bytes) associated with a movie.
missing_requirements.reason: An admin-guarded uploadMovieVideo(id, video : Storage.ExternalBlob) is present, but the diff does not show any explicit API to retrieve the stored video bytes (only getMovie returning Movie with videoBlob). If retrieval is intended as a dedicated bytes/download endpoint, it is not evidenced in the diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Upload progress tracking plumbing (onProgress callback, uploadProgress state, ExternalBlob.withUploadProgress) for video uploads in the admin dialog and mutations.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-8 does not require upload progress, and the BuildRequest explicitly lists real-time upload progress mechanisms as a non-goal (even if this implementation is client-side, it is still an unrequested feature addition).
